qa_pairs.question: What temperature should the rear case section be heated to in the area of the grooved ball bearing?
qa_pairs.answer: The rear case section should be heated to about 80°C (175°F) in the area of the grooved ball bearing.

qa_pairs.question: What special tool is used to drive the bearing shell with part number 00 5 500?
qa_pairs.answer: Special Tools 23 1 260 and 00 5 500 are used to drive the bearing shell into the front case section to fit tight.

qa_pairs.question: How should the layshaft be positioned when inserting Special Tool 23 1 280 into the bearing shell?
qa_pairs.answer: Insert the thicker end of Special Tool 23 1 280 in the bearing shell, and if necessary, remove the lock on the side of the drain plug.

qa_pairs.question: What is the important alignment requirement when installing the bearing shell?
qa_pairs.answer: The oil groove must be aligned with groove in case when installing the bearing shell that slot in bearing shell is aligned with turning lock bead in case.

qa_pairs.question: How many circlips are installed when checking axial play of the layshaft?
qa_pairs.answer: Install circlip (2) when checking axial play of the layshaft.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done with the closed cage end faces when installing the grooved ball bearing?
qa_pairs.answer: The closed cage end faces should be positioned down when installing the grooved ball bearing.

qa_pairs.question: What is installed in the rear case section along with the layshaft?
qa_pairs.answer: Install layshaft with roller bearings in rear case section.

qa_pairs.question: What special tool might be needed if driving against a stop?
qa_pairs.answer: If necessary, drive in against stop with Special Tool 24 1 060.

qa_pairs.question: What callout number identifies the special tool 33 4 020 in the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Callout number 33 4 020 identifies the special tool used in conjunction with Special Tool 23 1 300 to pull out the bearing shell.

qa_pairs.question: What must be installed before driving the bearing shell into the front case section?
qa_pairs.answer: Install old spacers before driving the bearing shell into the front case section to fit tight with Special Tool 23 1 260 and 00 5 500.
